short_description: AI on your phone. Free. Works in airplane mode.
full_description:
AGI runs on your device first. No cloud required, no account needed, no data leaving your phone for Local Mode.

Most AI apps funnel your conversations through remote servers. AGI is different: responses can be generated by an open-source language model running on your device. Airplane mode? Still works. No Wi-Fi? Still works.

WORKS OFFLINE
The default model downloads once over Wi-Fi and runs locally after that. No Local Mode inference calls hit AGI Cloud. Your local conversations stay on this device and are encrypted at rest.

FREE AT INFERENCE, FOREVER
Local on-device inference is free and always will be. There is no usage limit, no per-message charge, no subscription required to use the core chat.

CLOUD WHEN YOU CHOOSE IT
AGI Cloud is in public alpha: sign in for cloud chat and web search on the free tier, with image generation on Pro and above. There are no in-app purchases in this version.

PRIVACY FIRST
We do not claim full DPDP Act 2023 compliance. Our itemised India DPDP notice is published at https://agiworkforce.com/privacy/india, and the obligations we have not met — verifiable parental consent, notice in Eighth Schedule languages, and India data residency among them — are listed at https://agiworkforce.com/trust. AI output is labelled as AI-generated, and first run names the on-device model and any cloud provider. Local Mode collects no personal data by default. Signing in to AGI Cloud uses your account email (and name, if provided by your sign-in method) to create your account. Export or delete your local data at any time from Settings.

INDIA-FIRST
AGI is designed to work well on the connections and devices common across India: it runs offline, installs once, and handles Hindi queries.

Built by AGI Automation LLC, USA.
Support: support@agiworkforce.com
Privacy: https://agiworkforce.com/privacy

data_collected_types.collected_when: Only when the user signs in to use AGI Cloud (public alpha, open to any signed-in user).
Only if provided by the user's sign-in method when signing in to AGI Cloud.
Only in AGI Cloud: the messages the user sends are uploaded to AGI Cloud and forwarded to the model provider serving the request. Local Mode uploads nothing.
Only in AGI Cloud: photos attached to a message or set as the account avatar are uploaded.
Only in AGI Cloud: documents attached to a message are uploaded.
Only after sign-in: the account identifier carried by every authenticated cloud request.
Only after the user enables push notifications: an app-generated device UUID is registered with the push token. No advertising identifier is collected.

data_safety.note: Local Mode collects no personal data by default and uploads nothing. Signing in to AGI Cloud collects account email, optional name, account and device identifiers, and the conversation content and attachments the user sends. 'Data shared' stays false because the model providers, storage and push subprocessors listed at https://agiworkforce.com/subprocessors process that data on AGI's behalf under Play's service-provider exception, not for their own purposes.

in_app_products.note: Google Play Billing code SHIPS in the v1.2.0 binary and is deployment-gated OFF, so no product is purchasable and has_in_app_products stays false. What ships: expo-iap 5.3.0 is a dependency and a registered config plugin in apps/mobile/app.config.js, so the Play Billing client is linked, and src/features/billing/useMobileIap.ts drives a real purchase flow rendered by src/features/settings/cloud-billing/index.tsx. Why nothing can be bought: every purchase path requires GET /api/mobile/iap/catalog to report the catalog as enabled, and apps/web/lib/server/mobile-iap-catalog.ts only does that when MOBILE_IAP_ENABLED is set AND MOBILE_IAP_GOOGLE_PRODUCT_IDS_JSON maps at least one logical product key to a store ID. The gate fails closed, so with either missing the catalog comes back disabled with 'Native purchases are not enabled for this deployment.' and Settings > Billing renders the inert 'Native purchases are not configured' notice in place of the whole native-purchase area — no product row, no store price, no restore action, no store sheet. The checked-in env templates ship MOBILE_IAP_ENABLED=false and define no product-ID map (apps/web/.env.example, apps/web/.env.local.example); the live flag state is a deployment setting this repo cannot prove, and is confirmed off before every submission. The rest of that screen still renders the plan card, the plan-change row, the invoices row, and — for an active web-billed plan only — two static info blocks about proration and how a store top-up would be priced. No Play Console product exists for com.agiworkforce.app: MOBILE_IAP_PRODUCT_DEFINITIONS in packages/contracts/types/src/mobile-iap.ts holds logical keys only, and /api/mobile/iap/verify rejects any product it cannot resolve from that same gated catalog. The plan-change CTA never shows a price or a checkout, but it has two branches and only one is a sheet: an account with no subscription on record gets the in-app PaywallBottomSheet reading 'Plan changes aren't available in the app yet. Check back soon.' with no action button, while an account whose subscription is on record as bought elsewhere (web/Stripe or org-provisioned, and not cancelled or expired) gets a native 'Subscription managed elsewhere' alert whose second button opens agiworkforce.com/settings/billing externally — getSubscriptionOwnerGuard in src/features/billing/subscriptionSource.ts decides which branch. FEATURES.billing is false in apps/mobile/lib/v1FeatureFlags.ts so the web billing-portal link does not render. The full_description sentence 'There are no in-app purchases in this version.' stays accurate only because nothing is purchasable; rewrite it, and flip has_in_app_products, in the same change that registers products and enables MOBILE_IAP_ENABLED. Four external links remain, not three — 'View invoices' (paid accounts only), 'Contact Sales' (team/enterprise only), 'Workspace administration' (team admins only), and 'Manage on web' on the subscription-owner alert above (accounts with a subscription recorded from another platform); all four call sites verified 2026-08-27 in src/features/settings/cloud-billing/index.tsx, src/features/billing/subscriptionSource.ts and src/features/chat/components/PaywallBottomSheet.tsx. They are listed in docs/agent-context/known-flaws.md under MOBILE-IOS-3-1-1-EXTERNAL-LINKS, whose entry still records only the first three and must be corrected; Play's payments policy allows alternative billing far more readily than App Store Guideline 3.1.1, so the iOS review is the binding one.

release_notes_v1_2_0:
AGI 1.2 — Cloud public alpha.

• AGI Cloud is now open to any signed-in user — no invite or waitlist
• Cloud chat and web search on the free tier; image generation on Pro and above
• On-device AI chat still works fully offline, no account needed
• Catalog-selected on-device model downloads once and runs locally
• On-device voice transcription
• India DPDP notice published, with our open gaps listed at agiworkforce.com/trust

Email support@agiworkforce.com — we read everything.
